description: A roster entry can name the column that references the client, defaulting to `client_id`, and the generic mover updates that column.
Merging a client re-points `purchase_orders.drop_ship_client_id` from the absorbed client to the surviving client.
`contracts` (`owner_client_id`) is classified in the roster as handled explicitly, with the existing owned-contract and default-contract demotion behaviour unchanged.
The roster completeness check fails when any foreign key whose parent is `clients`, under any column name, has no roster classification.
The schema-drift integration check covers every column that references `clients`, not only columns named `client_id`.

Each reported non-FK client column (`telephony_call_records.matched_client_id`, `telephony_chat_records.matched_client_id`, `app_search_index.client_scope_id`) is verified, then either moved on merge or listed as left behind with a reason.
The merge result counts report drop-ship purchase orders moved.
